short_description: Planck function B_lambda, Teff 10-200,000 K (SVO bbody; 1/pi of a surface flux)
description: SVO's "Black Body" grid as SVO serves it: the Planck function B_lambda(T) for 588 temperatures from 10 to 200,000 K, 1 Angstrom to 10^7 Angstrom. These files are SVO's raw files, never cleaned: their headers declare no units in SED_Tools' form, and their flux is B_lambda, which integrates to sigma*T^4/pi, not sigma*T^4. MESA's own bbody cube is byte-identical. Held: not listed until it is relabelled as B_lambda or multiplied by pi as a new version (a decision for Nill).

bbb.is: a July 2026 re-cleaning of these 588 SVO bbody files (files named bbody_fid*.txt)
bbb.identical: 579 of 588 spectra have the same data lines as bbody's; the other 9 (bbody_fid417-fid425, 29,000-37,000 K) are bbody's flux times a constant 0.31-0.17 each, from the April 2026 renormalisation, so bbb is not a pure copy; its headers were rewritten with logg = nan and metallicity = nan
bbb.cube: empty: the NaN axes placed no spectrum
